about.title: Hi! I'm a Frontend Developer
about.description: I'm a frontend developer specializing in complex web applications, SaaS platforms, admin dashboards, and data-intensive interfaces. I have experience working with React and Vue 2/3, legacy codebases, real-time communication, automated testing, and performance optimization.
about.description_2: I value clean code, simple solutions, and architecture that allows a project to evolve without getting in the way.
about.description_3: Outside of commercial projects, I'm interested in open source and enjoy experimenting with new tools and approaches to frontend development.
